subject: general
question: A random sample of size 225 is drawn from the population of mean μ and standard deviation σ. The sample mean follows the distribution with mean 100 and standard distribution 4/3. The value of μ and σ are:
solution:
The correct answer is** (100, 20)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **sample mean** is an estimator of the population mean, but the true population mean is usually not known.
 
• The **standard deviation** of the sample mean decreases as the sample size increases.
 
• In general, **larger sample sizes** lead to more accurate estimates of population parameters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ​ **Additional Information__**

 
• The sample mean follows a normal distribution with mean 100 and standard deviation 4/3.
 
• The sample size is 225.
 
• The standard deviation of the population, σ, can be calculated using the formula σ = standard deviation of the sample mean * (square root of the sample size), where the standard deviation of the sample mean is 4/3.
 
• σ = 4/3 * (square root of 225) = 20
 
• So, the population mean is μ = 100 and the standard deviation is σ = 20.
